qs.q: A newborn presents in the delivery room with severe respiratory distress, a scaphoid abdomen, and diminished breath sounds on the left side. Heart sounds appear displaced. Which of the following initial ventilatory management steps should be strictly avoided?
o: Continuous positive airway pressure delivered through nasal prongs
Insertion of a large‑bore gastric decompression tube
qs.e: Bag-mask ventilation must be avoided in congenital diaphragmatic hernia because it can inflate the intrathoracic bowel, further compressing the hypoplastic lungs. Immediate intubation and gastric decompression are preferred.
qs.s: Neonatology 6: Congenital Conditions, Emergencies and Follow-up: MCQs
